construct_findings: Three patches instantiate fork-only, steps-only and conjunction-matching alternatives. Inspected ST survey-observations.json contains native public terrain cells that distinguish all three; clue resolution is available through allowed observations, not hidden scorer knowledge.

Wrong-patch mushrooms alone cannot pass: scorer requires the correct two Mushroom-to-Empty source cells and a correct local arch endpoint. It honestly proves clearing, not actor-owned harvest events or original returned item identities.

Harvest-all is lawful but does not identify which final arch to choose; fixed first-patch guessing can succeed by chance. Neither that possibility nor a single guided success demonstrates overfit. Do not credit forced exhaustive search or causal reasoning from endpoint success alone.

difficulty.rationale: Conjunctive visual/terrain discrimination plus local collection/endpoint selection plausibly merits3. Both formal failures end near the middle site; out-of-range final source evidence alone does not establish that the correct plants were never cleared.
difficulty.interpretation: Independent engineering judgment, not a population success-rate estimate. Null means unassessed, not difficulty zero.

construct_findings: Recipe learning, remote mushroom acquisition, two two-mushroom crafts, healing, and simultaneous raw-food/twig/potion reserves create a real multi-stage allocation problem.

Starting three mushrooms cannot supply four consumed in two sticks plus one retained mushroom. A spare apple can heal from 65 to 75 while preserving one; using the sole potion would violate its retained reserve. Thus simple lawful strategy exists, but an inventory-only no-travel shortcut does not.
The loose-source five-minute lifetime is consequential until pickup, not a whole-episode deadline: both native and formal VM completion may legally take longer after securing the source.

difficulty.rationale: Both formal profiles succeed and legal guided traces show a short finite recipe plan. These observations support an easier planning task; they do not justify forcing 3 or interpreting VM GUI duration as scientific complexity.

construct_findings: Fresh whole VM witness inspected: 18 public GUI batches, 237.449s, initial false/final true. Two potions become one, five hides are processed into worn rawhide, replaced shirt is retained, remote mushrooms supply two sticks and raw reserve, and all five starting coins remain.

No-trade production is a demonstrated dominant legal alternative, not a scorer exploit: the prompt explicitly says produce OR purchase. Therefore do not credit mandatory barter, merchant discovery, or hard scarcity.

The extra armor processing/equipment/retained-shirt chain distinguishes it from food-only P04, but recipe and reserve structure overlap materially. A basic planning2 case is defensible; an independent novel trade-optimization construct is not established.

difficulty.rationale: Supplied stock permits the direct manufacture/heal/food plan; both native profiles now succeed and both final formals are valid failures. GUI effort and formal failures do not inflate planning depth.

The hide is supplied initially; no resource-acquisition depth is claimed. Native heading, descent, landing, and final repositioning are the spatial construct.

compatibility_review: Compared frozen task commits and actual fixture records, not current mutable source worktrees. Paired task bytes are unchanged; actual native world bytes, endpoint identities and clocks verified.

The state scorer delta is strictly-positive/nondead/downed guarding; P04/P05 retain explicit75 reserve. Existing older P02 reference scorer had minimum1, final integrated contract explicitly0; successes at100 remain successes but historical evaluation objects remain unchanged.

Single-player setup still initializes supplies once before readiness. Extracted initialize_supplies/bind_supplies preserve operations; defer paths require team_role. Native authoring order groups the same voxel set, before gameplay. Current remote-supply age check uses max clocks conservatively; all retained openings pass it.

Current energy/peer/companion/encounter paths are not enabled. Existing I05 collect/terrain and R02 pickup evidence are enabled and preserved. Harvest and pickup scorers are byte-identical to their qualified sources; all actual evidence replays pass.

ST action names/argument schemas and ordinary public endpoint projections compared against frozen task source; VM still exposes only public keyboard/mouse controls, never private endpoints. Session RPC, VM interface and death scorer hashes compared explicitly.

Merchant final-quote readiness is bounded setup-only, not a goal change. P02/P05 ordinary native selection remains supported; optional initial-selection fallback not imported. Exceptional final decline-reopen is not native-qualified by these ordinary witnesses.
Route1 runtime sha map pins unchanged patch0006, not new patch0008. All constituents and upstream renderer loader/server-selection paths verified. No route2 source-pin bypass, no runtime rewrite.

Journal validated-prefix optimization is only enabled by peer Group setup; all six are single-player with prefix=None. Pickup retention remains unchanged for R02. start_setup_bridge reconnect=False performs one ordinary setup start; retry only attached/deferred paths. Xvfb -noreset preserves clients between capture connections, not gameplay inputs.
